string z8_to_utf8(wstring value) { return value.to!string; }
wstring z8_message(Throwable value) { return value.msg.to!wstring; }
wstring z8_stacktrace(Throwable value) { return value.toString().to!wstring; }
wstring z8_string_required(wstring value) {
    if (value is null) throw new Exception("null string");
    return value;
}
wstring z8_string_or_empty(wstring value) { return value is null ? ""w : value; }
wstring z8_string_new(wstring value) {
    if (value is null) return null;
    auto buffer = new wchar[value.length + 1];
    buffer[0 .. value.length] = value[];
    return cast(wstring)buffer[0 .. value.length];
}
void z8_string_add_assign(ref wstring left, wstring right) {
    left = z8_nullable_string_binary!"+"(left, z8_string_or_empty(right));
}
auto z8_nullable_string_binary(string op)(wstring value, wstring other) {
    value = z8_string_required(value);
    static if (op == "+") { auto result = value ~ other; return result.length ? result : ""w; }
    else static if (op == "==") return value == other;
    else static if (op == "!=") return value != other;
    else static if (op == "<") return z8_str_compare(value, other) < 0;
    else static if (op == ">") return z8_str_compare(value, other) > 0;
    else static if (op == "<=") return z8_str_compare(value, other) <= 0;
    else static if (op == ">=") return z8_str_compare(value, other) >= 0;
    else static assert(0, "unsupported nullable string operation");
}
auto z8_nullable_string_call(string name, Args...)(wstring value, Args args) {
    value = z8_string_required(value);
    static if (name == "length") return cast(long)value.length;
    else static if (name == "isEmpty") return value.length == 0;
    else static if (name == "toString") return value;
    else return mixin("z8_str_" ~ name ~ "(value, args)");
}
// A Z8 object reference is created before its object is initialized.  The
// stages are advanced before invoking user code, matching CLASS.get(stage).
class Z8Object {
    private int z8_stage = -1;
    private bool z8_allocated;
    private Z8Object z8_container;

    final void z8_set_container(Z8Object container) { z8_container = container; }
    final void z8_ensure(int requested = 1) {
        if (z8_container !is null && z8_container.z8_stage < requested)
            z8_container.z8_ensure(requested);
        if (!z8_allocated) {
            z8_allocate_fields();
            z8_allocated = true;
        }
        if (z8_stage < 0 && requested >= 0) {
            z8_stage = 0;
            z8_init_references();
            z8_init_members();
        }
        if (z8_stage < 1 && requested >= 1) {
            z8_stage = 1;
            z8_init_values();
            z8_call_constructor();
        }
    }
    void z8_allocate_fields() {}
    void z8_init_references() {}
    void z8_init_members() {}
    void z8_init_values() {}
    void z8_call_constructor() {}
}
T z8_new(T)(Z8Object container = null) {
    auto value = new T();
    value.z8_set_container(container);
    return value;
}
T z8_nonnull(T)(T value, int requested = 1) {
    if (value is null) throw new Exception("null reference");
    static if (is(T : Z8Object)) value.z8_ensure(requested);
    return value;
}
T z8_elvis(T)(T value, lazy T fallback) { return value !is null ? value : fallback; }
struct Z8Optional(T) {
    bool present; T value;
    T z8_value() { return z8_optional_require(this); }
    alias z8_value this;
    void opAssign(T newValue) { present = true; value = newValue; }
}
Z8Optional!T z8_optional_wrap(T)(T value) { return Z8Optional!T(true, value); }
bool z8_optional_is_null(T)(Z8Optional!T value) { return !value.present; }
T z8_optional_require(T)(Z8Optional!T value) {
    if (!value.present) throw new Exception("null primitive");
    return value.value;
}
T z8_optional_elvis(T)(Z8Optional!T value, lazy T fallback) { return value.present ? value.value : fallback; }
Z8Optional!T z8_optional_elvis_optional(T)(Z8Optional!T value, lazy Z8Optional!T fallback) { return value.present ? value : fallback; }
bool z8_optional_bool_binary(string op)(Z8Optional!bool left, lazy Z8Optional!bool right) {
    static if (op == "&&") return z8_optional_require(left) && z8_optional_require(right);
    else static if (op == "||") return z8_optional_require(left) || z8_optional_require(right);
    else {
        auto other = right;
        auto value = z8_optional_require(left);
        if (!other.present) return false;
        static if (op == "==") return value == other.value;
        else return value != other.value;
    }
}
auto z8_optional_int_binary(string op)(Z8Optional!long left, Z8Optional!long right) {
    auto a = z8_optional_require(left);
    static if (op == "==" || op == "!=" || op == "<" || op == ">" || op == "<=" || op == ">=") {
        if (!right.present) return false;
        static if (op == "==") return a == right.value;
        else static if (op == "!=") return a != right.value;
        else static if (op == "<") return a < right.value;
        else static if (op == ">") return a > right.value;
        else static if (op == "<=") return a <= right.value;
        else return a >= right.value;
    } else {
        auto b = z8_optional_require(right);
        static if (op == "+") return a + b;
        else static if (op == "-") return a - b;
        else static if (op == "*") return a * b;
        else static if (op == "/") return z8_div(a, b);
        else static if (op == "%") return z8_mod(a, b);
        else static if (op == "&") return a & b;
        else static if (op == "|") return a | b;
        else static if (op == "^") return a ^ b;
        else static assert(0, "unsupported optional integer operation");
    }
}
auto z8_optional_decimal_binary(string op)(Z8Optional!Z8Decimal left, Z8Optional!Z8Decimal right) {
    auto a = z8_optional_require(left);
    if (!right.present) {
        static if (op == "==" || op == ">" || op == ">=") return false;
        else static if (op == "!=" || op == "<" || op == "<=") return true;
        else throw new Exception("null decimal");
    }
    auto b = right.value;
    return mixin("a " ~ op ~ " b");
}
auto z8_optional_mixed(string op, bool intOnLeft, A, B)(A left, B right) {
    static if (intOnLeft) {
        auto number = z8_optional_require(left);
        if (!right.present) {
            static if (op == "==") return false;
            else throw new Exception("null decimal");
        }
        auto a = z8_decimal_from_int(number);
        auto b = right.value;
        static if (op == "<") return a <= b;
        else static if (op == "<=") return a < b;
        else static if (op == ">") return a >= b;
        else static if (op == ">=") return a > b;
        else return mixin("a " ~ op ~ " b");
    } else {
        auto a = z8_optional_require(left);
        auto b = z8_decimal_from_int(z8_optional_require(right));
        return mixin("a " ~ op ~ " b");
    }
}
void z8_optional_decimal_assign(string op)(ref Z8Optional!Z8Decimal left, Z8Optional!Z8Decimal right) {
    left = z8_optional_wrap(z8_optional_decimal_binary!op(left, right));

auto z8_optional_decimal_call(string name, Args...)(Z8Optional!Z8Decimal value, Args args) {
    auto number = z8_optional_require(value);
    static if (name == "toString") return number.z8_string();
    else static if (name == "signum") return number.z8_signum();
    else static if (name == "ceil") return number.z8_ceil();
    else static if (name == "floor") return number.z8_floor();
    else static if (name == "round" && Args.length == 0) return number.z8_round_int();
    else static if (name == "round") return number.z8_round(args);
    else static if (["abs", "sin", "cos", "tan", "asin", "acos", "atan", "sinh", "cosh", "tanh", "toRadians", "toDegrees", "exp", "ln", "log10", "sqrt", "cbrt", "power"].canFind(name)) return z8_decimal_math!name(number, args);
    else static assert(0, "unsupported decimal method");
}

    else static if (op == "~") return ~number;

auto z8_invoke(string name, T, Args...)(T value, Args args) {
    if (value is null) throw new Exception("null reference");
    return __traits(getMember, value, name)(args);

ref auto z8_array_at(T)(Z8Array!T value, long index) {
    return z8_nonnull(value).z8_at(index);
}
Z8Array!T z8_array_union(T)(Z8Array!T left, Z8Array!T right) {
    auto result = new Z8Array!T();
    result.z8_addAll(z8_nonnull(left));
    result.z8_addAll(z8_nonnull(right));
    return result;
}

T z8_cast(T, U)(U value) {
    auto result = cast(T)value;
    if (value !is null && result is null) throw new Exception("invalid object cast");
    return result;
}
long z8_div(long a, long b) {
    if (b == 0) throw new Exception("division by zero");
    if (a == long.min && b == -1) return long.min;
    return a / b;
}
long z8_mod(long a, long b) {
    if (b == 0) throw new Exception("division by zero");
    if (a == long.min && b == -1) return 0;
    return a % b;
}
void z8_div_assign(ref long a, long b) { a = z8_div(a, b); }
void z8_mod_assign(ref long a, long b) { a = z8_mod(a, b); }
bool z8_string_equals(wstring a, wstring b) { return a is null ? b is null : b !is null && a == b; }
